summary: FS KKR Capital Corp filed an 8-K on June 8, 2026, reporting entry into a Sixteenth Supplemental Indenture for the issuance of $900 million aggregate principal amount of 7.500% notes due 2031. The notes are general unsecured obligations, mature August 1, 2031, interest payable semi-annually, and redeemable at the company's option. This is a routine debt financing by a business development company, not a special situation event.
